This code chunk loads the required packages and the data.
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(boot)
library(ggpattern)
library(lamW)

#posterior data from CYER ~ FMI relationship
ER_post <- readRDS("data\\fmi_cyer_posterior_predictions.rds") %>% 
   filter(fmi %in% c(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4))

#read in posterior estimate for Ricker alpha for Spring 1.3
fit <- readRDS("R//sp_su_1.3_fit.RDS")
alpha_su <- as.vector(extract(fit)[11])$alpha

set.seed(1352)
```


This code chunk retrieves the simulation results from the folders and combines them into a single dataframe.
```{r, read in scenario outputs}

#retrieving the basic simulation parameterization
# simPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\SimPars_su_opti.csv")
# CUPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\CUPars_su_opti.csv")

# simPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\SimPars_su_pess.csv")
# CUPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\CUPars_su_pess.csv")
# 
simPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\SimPars_su-impl.csv")
CUPar <- read.csv("SP_SU_1.3\\samsim pars\\CUPars_su-impl.csv")

#regenerating alpha_nu to extract the simultation results from the output folders
alpha_nu <- seq(from = 0.25, to = 2.0, length.out = 10)

#creating an empty list to store a dataframe for each value of alpha tested
srdat_aq <- list()

#extracting the dataframes of results
for(k in 1:length(alpha_nu)){
   hcrDatalist<-list()
   srData<- list()
   for(a in seq_len(nrow(simPar))){
      hcrDatalist[[a]] <- readRDS(paste("./outputs",alpha_nu[k],"/SamSimOutputs/simData/",
                                         simPar$nameOM[a],"/", 
                                         simPar$scenario[a],"/",
                                         paste(simPar$nameOM[a],"_", simPar$nameMP[a], "_",
                                               "CU_HCR_PM.RData",sep=""), sep=""))$hcrDatout
      hcrDatalist[[a]]$scenario<-simPar$scenario[a]
      hcrDatalist[[a]]$nameOM<-simPar$nameOM[a]
      hcrDatalist[[a]]$nameMP<-simPar$nameMP[a]
      
      srData[[a]] <- readRDS(paste("./outputs",alpha_nu[k],"/SamSimOutputs/simData/", 
                         simPar$nameOM[a],"/",
                         simPar$scenario[a],"/",
                         paste(simPar$nameOM[a],"_", simPar$nameMP[a], "_", "CUsrDat.RData",sep=""), sep=""))$srDatout
      srData[[a]]$scenario<-simPar$scenario[a]
      srData[[a]]$nameOM<-simPar$nameOM[a]
      srData[[a]]$nameMP<-simPar$nameMP[a]
      }
   hcrdat <- do.call(rbind,hcrDatalist)
   srdat<- do.call(rbind,srData)
   hcrdat<-hcrdat[hcrdat$year>0,] #remove burn-in period
   srdat<-srdat[srdat$year>0,]
   
   #hcrdat maybe not needed - has catch statistics though
   hcrdat=hcrdat[order(hcrdat$scenario,hcrdat$iteration,hcrdat$CU,hcrdat$year),]
   srdat=srdat[order(srdat$scenario,srdat$iteration,srdat$CU,srdat$year),]
   
   srdat_aq[[k]] <- srdat
}

#converting from a list of dataframes to a single comprehensive dataframe
sim_out <- bind_rows(srdat_aq, .id = "column_label")

```

The raw simulation outputs (sim_out) are broken out at the individual CU level. In the code chunk below, sim_out is summarized at the CU- and SMU-level, and then evaluated against:

1) CU-level lower benchmarks (20% Smax or 1500 spawners, whichever number is higher).
2) CU-level quasi-extinction threshold (50 spawners).
3) SMU-level Limit Reference Point, where both CUs need to be above 20% Smax or 1500 spawners (whichever is more for a given CU) for the SMU to be above the LRP.

The success of each trial examines the probability of the geometric mean of the last generation of the simulation (5 years in this case) meeting the conditions laid out above.

```{r sim output summarization}

sim_sum <- sim_out %>% mutate(CU_ID = ifelse(CU == 1, "CK-05",
                                             ifelse(CU == 2, "CK-06",
                                                    ifelse(CU == 3, "CK-09",
                                                           ifelse(CU == 4, "CK-11",
                                                                  ifelse(CU == 5, "CK-14","CK-19")))))) %>% 
                                 dplyr::select(iteration, year, CU_ID, CU, scenario, spawners, beta, alpha, sigma) %>% 
   mutate(targetER = as.numeric(substr(scenario, 3, nchar(scenario))))

sim_sum_ER <- sim_out %>% mutate(CU_ID = ifelse(CU == 1, "CK-05",
                                             ifelse(CU == 2, "CK-06",
                                                    ifelse(CU == 3, "CK-09",
                                                           ifelse(CU == 4, "CK-11",
                                                                  ifelse(CU == 5, "CK-14","CK-19")))))) %>% 
                                 dplyr::select(iteration, year, CU, scenario, ER) %>% 
   mutate(targetER = as.numeric(substr(scenario, 3, nchar(scenario))))


#read in RDS with lower biological benchmarks (0.2 Smax)
summ_smax0.2 <- readRDS("smax0.2.RDS")

#threshold set to 1500 or 20% Smax, whichever value is higher (consistent with Rapid Status Approach)
sim_sum_CU <- sim_sum %>%
   filter(year %in% c(91:95)) %>%  
   group_by(CU_ID, CU, alpha, targetER, scenario, iteration) %>%
   summarize(geo_mean_gen = exp(mean(log(spawners)))) %>% 
   mutate(cu_fail = ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[3,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[3,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-19" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[11,2]], 1, 0)))))))))))) %>% 
   group_by(CU_ID, CU, alpha, targetER, scenario) %>%
   summarize(p_fail = mean(cu_fail))

#LBB set to 20% Smax for all CUs - contrasts with above by showing outcomes relative to watershed area-based capacity
sim_sum_CU_LBB <- sim_sum %>%
   filter(year %in% c(91:95)) %>%  
   group_by(CU_ID, CU, alpha, targetER, scenario, iteration) %>%
   summarize(geo_mean_gen = exp(mean(log(spawners)))) %>% 
   mutate(cu_fail = ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[2,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[2,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[3,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[3,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[5,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[5,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[9,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[9,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-19" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[11,2]], 1, 0)))))))))))) %>% 
   group_by(CU_ID, CU, alpha, targetER, scenario) %>%
   summarize(p_fail = mean(cu_fail))

#Summarizing at the SMU level to examine likelihood of exceeding CU-status-based LRP
sim_sum_SMU <- sim_sum %>% filter(year %in% c(91:95)) %>% 
   group_by(CU_ID, CU, alpha, targetER, scenario, iteration) %>%
   summarize(geo_mean_gen = exp(mean(log(spawners)))) %>% 
   mutate(cu_fail = ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-05" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-06" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-09" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-11" & geo_mean_gen < summ_smax0.2[[7,2]], 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen >= 1500, 1,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-14" & geo_mean_gen < 1500, 0,
                           ifelse(CU_ID == "CK-19" & geo_mean_gen >= summ_smax0.2[[11,2]], 1, 0)))))))))))) %>% 
   group_by(alpha, targetER, scenario, iteration) %>%
   summarize(smu_fail = ifelse(mean(cu_fail) < 1, 0, 1)) %>% 
   group_by(alpha, targetER, scenario) %>% 
   summarize(p_fail = mean(smu_fail))

```


The following code chunks create icecream plots that illustrate the probability of exceeding the thresholds detailed above (1-3). Note that the secondary y-axes are coded to show the equivalent FMI for a given CYER measure.

This chunk defines a function for converting CYER to FMI which is used to calculate the secondary axes in the icecream plots.
Code chunk for going back and forth between CYER and FMI for secondary Y-axis. *To be coded when FMI~CYER analysis is finished*
```{r ER transform}

i_o = -1.54
s_o = 0.400
i_p = -1.28
s_p = 0.0843

FMI = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)

opti <- function(FMI){
   CYER = inv.logit(FMI * s_o + i_o)
   print(CYER)
}

df_opti <- data.frame(FMI, opti(FMI)) %>% 
   dplyr::select(FMI, CYER = opti.FMI.)

anns_opti <- df_opti[FMI %in% seq(0, 0.4, by = 0.1), ]

pess <- function(targetER){
   CYER = inv.logit(FMI * s_p + i_p)
   print(CYER)
}

df_pess <- data.frame(FMI, pess(FMI)) %>% 
   dplyr::select(FMI, CYER = pess.FMI.)

anns_pess <- df_pess[FMI %in% seq(0, 0.4, by = 0.1), ]

```

ER <- unique(sim_sum_ER$targetER)

   geom_line(aes(x = year, y = ER, group = as.factor(iteration)), alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.2)+

   facet_wrap(.~ as.factor(targetER))+
   labs(x = "Year", y = "ER")+
   theme_classic()

get_legend <- function(plot, legend = NULL) {
  
  gt <- ggplotGrob(plot)
  
  pattern <- "guide-box"
  if (!is.null(legend)) {
    pattern <- paste0(pattern, "-", legend)
  }
  
  indices <- grep(pattern, gt$layout$name)

  not_empty <- !vapply(
    gt$grobs[indices], 
    inherits, what = "zeroGrob", 
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
  indices <- indices[not_empty]
  
  if (length(indices) > 0) {
    return(gt$grobs[[indices[1]]])
  }
  return(NULL)
}

legend1 = get_legend(CU_plot[[1]] +

CU_plot <- list()
for(i in 1:length(unique(sim_sum_CU$CU_ID))){
   CU_plot[[i]] <- sim_sum_CU %>% filter(CU == i)  %>% mutate(fail = ifelse(p_fail <= 0.04, "Very Low (0.00-0.04)",
                                          ifelse(p_fail > 0.04 & p_fail <= 0.24, "Low (0.05-0.24)",
                                                 ifelse(p_fail > 0.24 & p_fail <= 0.49, "Moderately Low (0.25-0.49)",
                                                        ifelse(p_fail > 0.49 & p_fail <= 0.74, "Moderately High (0.50-0.74)",
                                                               ifelse(p_fail > 0.74 & p_fail <= 0.94, "High (0.75-0.94)",
                                                                      "Very High (0.95-1.00)"))))),
                               CU = ifelse(CU_ID == 1, "CK-05",
                                           ifelse(CU_ID == 2, "CK-06",
                                                  ifelse(CU_ID == 3, "CK-09",
                                                         ifelse(CU_ID == 4, "CK-11",
                                                                ifelse(CU_ID == 5, "CK-14","CK-19")))))) %>% 
   ggplot(aes(x = alpha, y = targetER, z = fail, fill = fail))+
   geom_tile(show.legend = c(fill = TRUE))+
   scale_fill_manual(values = Ccols, 
                     name = "P(Conservation Unit\n> 1500 or 20% Smax)",
                     breaks = rev(c("Very Low (0.00-0.04)", "Low (0.05-0.24)", "Moderately Low (0.25-0.49)",
                                    "Moderately High (0.50-0.74)", "High (0.75-0.94)", "Very High (0.95-1.00)")),
                     drop = F,
                     limits = rev(c("Very Low (0.00-0.04)", "Low (0.05-0.24)", "Moderately Low (0.25-0.49)",
                                    "Moderately High (0.50-0.74)", "High (0.75-0.94)", "Very High (0.95-1.00)")))+
   scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                      breaks = c(0.25, 0.83, 1.42, 2.00),
                      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ (1-lambertW0(exp(1-.))),
                                          name = expression(paste(italic("U")[MSY])),
                                          breaks = c(0.12, 0.37, 0.57, 0.72)))+
   scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0),
                      breaks = all_breaks,
                      labels = my_labels)+
   geom_vline(xintercept = median(alpha_su), colour = "grey20", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1)+
   labs(y = "CAN CYER", 
        x = expression(paste("Productivity [ln(",italic(α),")]"))) + 
   theme_classic() +
   theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
         legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
         legend.box = "horizontal")#may need to make additional adjustments to create a wide and skinny legend
}

get_legend <- function(plot, legend = NULL) {
  
  gt <- ggplotGrob(plot)
  
  pattern <- "guide-box"
  if (!is.null(legend)) {
    pattern <- paste0(pattern, "-", legend)
  }
  
  indices <- grep(pattern, gt$layout$name)

  not_empty <- !vapply(
    gt$grobs[indices], 
    inherits, what = "zeroGrob", 
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  )
  indices <- indices[not_empty]
  
  if (length(indices) > 0) {
    return(gt$grobs[[indices[1]]])
  }
  return(NULL)
}
